references.title: Niche Construction: The Neglected Process in Evolution
references.author: Odling-Smee, F. John and Laland, Kevin N. and Feldman, Marcus W.
references.note: Niche construction --- organisms actively modifying their own and others' selective environments. Cited by the source paper and used by the cell-environment-coupling-spatial flagship study, where a single cell reshapes the very nutrient gradient it depends on. Key `odling1996' follows the paper's own citation; the foundational 1996 statement is Odling-Smee, Laland \& Feldman, "Niche construction", Am. Nat. 147(4):641--648.
